pages.text: The final goal: build the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() in Hyperdimensional Reality Space. Simulate the Tree as an $(item)Arbor Simulacrum$() and the Ocean as a $(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$().
Then join them with an $(item)Omega Point$(). Tipler's Omega Point is the end-state where computation embraces everything - a fitting seal.$(br2)Hold the $(item)Omnilex$() and you may fly.

With the two simulacra the engine can grow new bubble universes, rewrite laws into crystals, or simulate everything that will ever be, down to the Omega Point.$(br2)Last entry for tonight. I am not sure there is anything left to discover. I am almost sure I am wrong.
Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
